I wrote `component.html` in the folder, following `DESIGN.md` and inlining the tokens from `tokens.css`. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Layout:** `#component` is 1280px wide on white. The content is one centered column (max 1120px) with 48px above it and 32px side padding.
- **Top row:** "Team" is on the left in Unbounded Light capitals. "Invite Member" is on the right as the single primary button (ink pill, 44px tall).
- **Member list:** The five members sit in one card. The header row (Name, Email, Role) uses the label style. Each member row is 52px tall with 1px dividers. Name and email are plain text, and each role select starts on the role you gave.
- **Selects:** They are 44px tall, use the site's font, and have a 2px accent focus ring.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available here, since the folder has no font files. The page uses the fallback fonts that `tokens.css` lists, so the heading and body text will look different from the real site.
- **Header row:** I added the Name, Email and Role header row because `DESIGN.md` asks for one on lists. It's the only content beyond what you specified.
